sections.changelog:
0.15.3

  • Hardened Rent Fetch API bootstrap caching so error responses no longer replace cached credential/token data.
  • Validated central API bootstrap responses before caching them as successful.
  • Prevented Yardi floorplan orphan cleanup from running against blank, malformed, missing-key, request-error, or non-200 floorplan API responses.
  • Preserved legitimate Yardi empty-floorplan cleanup behavior when the API explicitly returns a valid empty floorplans array.
